messages.content: Rong has been saving 20 coins in his piggy bank every month. Neil has been saving 2/5 times more coins in his piggy bank per month than Rong. How many coins are they having ten years after they started their savings?

content.text:
# Solving the Savings Problem

## Setting Up the Problem

**Rong's monthly savings:** 20 coins

**Neil's monthly savings:** 
Neil saves 2/5 times MORE than Rong
- Additional amount: (2/5) × 20 = 8 coins
- Neil's total: 20 + 8 = 28 coins per month

## Calculating Total Savings Over 10 Years

**Time period:** 10 years = 10 × 12 = 120 months

**Rong's total:**
$$20 \times 120 = 2{,}400 \text{ coins}$$

**Neil's total:**
$$28 \times 120 = 3{,}360 \text{ coins}$$

**Combined total:**
$$2{,}400 + 3{,}360 = 5{,}760 \text{ coins}$$

## Answer

Together, they will have **5,760 coins** ten years after they started their savings.
